text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can produce paintings, compose music, and even write stories that look surprisingly human. Some people are impressed by these creations, while others feel uneasy. The main question is: can machines truly be creative, or are they just copying patterns? A human artist draws from emotions, personal experiences, and cultural context. An AI, on the other hand, analyzes millions of examples and combines them in new ways. This is not the same as imagination, but it can inspire us. Many artists now use AI as a tool, like a digital paintbrush, to explore fresh ideas. In the end, perhaps the most valuable creativity is still human—AI simply offers us new starting points.
